title: References
use_cases: Use when citing foundational theories of indicative and subjunctive conditionals.
Implement when modeling logical frameworks for branching time and ontic necessity.
Configure when referencing semantic theories by Kratzer, Lewis, or Stalnaker.
Use when investigating the formal representation of context updates in logical theories.
